title: ACP2 Scientific Question
description: Frozen scientific question contract for the limited ACP2 research questions. It declares the question type, hypothesis references, required evidence types, the four-valued claim-status vocabulary, and the comparison conditions that must be compatible before any claim is evaluated. It carries no LLM/model role, cost/price, budget, queue/account or platform job status.

schema_version.description: Question contract major version. Unknown majors are rejected, never coerced.

question_type.description: Limited initial scope: a connectivity question asks whether a declared path connects the endpoints; an activation-energy question compares energies under frozen compatible conditions. It never implies endo/exo selectivity or a global mechanism.

hypothesis_refs.description: References to the hypotheses this question evaluates. A hypothesis is not a model prompt or a role.

required_evidence_types.description: Evidence kinds the question needs. Each item is evaluated independently; one imaginary frequency never proves connectivity and one IRC direction never proves a bidirectional path.

claim_status_vocabulary.description: The frozen four-valued scientific claim vocabulary. Execution terminal state is never mapped onto 'supported'.

multiplicity.description: Spin multiplicity (2S+1). No default is implied.

state_id.description: Optional reference to an ElectronicStateSpec state_id (cccp/calculation/contracts.py ElectronicStateSpec). Null means unnamed, not a guessed state.

comparison_conditions.description: Scientific comparability envelope. Energies or path claims are comparable only when every declared compatibility requirement is satisfied; absence is not a silent match.

method.description: Method identity shared by the compared results (for example a composite method or functional/basis label).

reference_state.description: Named reference state used by the comparison (for example separated reactants at infinite distance). Null must be declared in unknown_fields.

energy_unit.description: Explicit unit. Values are never compared across different units without conversion provenance.

compatibility_requirements.description: Which conditions must match exactly before a comparison is evaluated. The validator reports the first unsatisfied requirement instead of widening the comparison.

unknown_fields.description: Declared unknown comparison conditions using dotted paths (for example 'temperature_k'). A null condition must be listed here; it is never defaulted to a room-temperature or 1-bar value.
